quest.title: Saurian Versus Mountain
quest.description: Tlatem, from the Children of Echoes' tribal settlement, is presently troubled by a certain matter...

dialogues.speaker: Tlatem
dialogues.text: He doesn't like you, so scram!

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Thief
dialogues.text: Little runt... What's with you and the Saurian? You know him or something?

dialogues.speaker: Qica
dialogues.text: Roar... Rawrrrr!

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Thief
dialogues.text: Oh, look, he's getting impatient. Alright then, whelp, stand aside. We don't hit kids.

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Thief
dialogues.text: Bring the bag, boys. Bet you this Saurian'll sell for a good price.

dialogues.speaker: Tlatem
dialogues.text: Don't come any closer! And don't blame me if you get hurt!

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Thief
dialogues.text: W—Wait, you mean you're going to hit us? Hahahaha! You hear that, boys? He's gonna take us on!

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Thief
dialogues.text: Ooh, kiddo, I'm sho scared, I'm twembling in my bwoots. But if you say so... don't blame me if you get hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Qica
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawrrr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Impatient Thief
dialogues.text: Tch... Isn't this Saurian a noisy one. Alright, kid, just go have a nap over—

choices.text: You're the ones who could use a nap.

response.speaker: Tlatem
response.text: #{M#Big Bro}{F#Big Sis}! They're trying to take Qica!

response.speaker: Impatient Thief
response.text: ...Hey, you. How about you step aside? We won't hurt you. Heck, we'll give you a share. How's that sound?

response.speaker: Impatient Thief
response.text: Huh. Guess that's that, then. Well, I'm sure you know the rules. Let's get dangerous!

choices.text: Who died and made you king?
Hope you don't mind if I chip in.

dialogues.speaker: Tlatem
dialogues.text: #Thanks for saving us, {M#Big Bro}{F#Big Sis}.

dialogues.speaker: Qica
dialogues.text: Hrroo, roooh...

dialogues.speaker: Tlatem
dialogues.text: This place was too far from the tribe — if you hadn't shown up, there's no way I'd have been able to alert Illapa before Qica got caught.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you two doing over here, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Tlatem
dialogues.text: Climbing practice, as always — but we got hungry halfway through.

dialogues.speaker: Tlatem
dialogues.text: So the two of us went foraging... But before we knew it, we'd wandered off pretty far...

dialogues.speaker: Tlatem
dialogues.text: By the time we'd had our fill, we were a long, long way out. Mom's going to give it to me for sure when we get back...

dialogues.speaker: Tlatem
dialogues.text: Thanks again for saving us. Take these Cacahuatls — I only just plucked 'em!

dialogues.speaker: Tlatem
dialogues.text: We'll head back as quick as we can. Come on, Qica!

dialogues.speaker: Qica
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawrrr! Rawr!
